title: apache/maka: a local-first workspace with auditable agent histories
friendlyTitle: Apache Maka keeps a clear history of agent actions
summary: Apache Maka is an incubating local-first AI agent workspace that records model messages, tool calls, results, permission decisions, and termination events in an append-only log. It had about 2,800 stars and active development when checked.
friendlySummary: Maka is a local-first workspace that records an AI agent’s messages, tool use, results, and permission choices.
whyItMatters: Teams can use Maka to run and inspect agent workflows while retaining a durable history of what the model requested, what tools did, and which permissions were granted.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can help you review what an agent did and understand mistakes after a task finishes.
